notes.title: Scrapvival 0.2.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Bringing some minor hotfixes for Scrapvival!

Fixed bugs and optimized in-game chat
Optimized robot AI system
Fixed vending machines getting stuck

notes.title: Scrapvival 0.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Added placeable turrets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41464057/f87b1ad10d3d63924b13883076630f2b8df96fe5.png
Added perk system (Speed Soda, Rage Soda, Health Soda)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41464057/a6d4baa90095250cf1dc210d89df362def0f2fa3.png
Speed Soda (gives you fast running speed and very slow stamina decrease)
Health Soda (gives you up to 250% HP and fast regeneration)
Rage Soda (gives you 10 times more strength on fist punches and slightly faster running speed)
Each soda effect will last only 2 minutes, after that your abilities will return to normal
In order for vending machine to work the nearest generator to it needs to be running
Jumping now requires stamina (not less than 20%)
Default sprint time was prolonged to 10 seconds
Added controls overview in options menu
Glock bullets are no longer physics projectille based, improved glock aiming
Fixed bug with escape menu appearing while leaving generator UI
Added UI stats indicators to generators and turrets
Added sitting animation when player is in the helicopter
Robots can no longer walk through yellow barrels
Added antiflip mechanism to helicopter

notes.title: Scrapvival 0.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Improved helicopter controls
Players can now only have one bat
Fuel cans and bats will now drop after players is dead
All pickable items are glowing to make them more visible
Added "Waiting for other players" mechanic to start of the game
Robots will now drop scrap after players destroy them
Player spectate cam, players can now spectate other players once dead
Improved Glock bullet accuracy

notes.title: Scrapvival 0.0.7 Update
notes.content:
Fixed helicopter gas not updating on client side
Major "Fly Here" red circle different position on each client fixed
Added inner lights to helicopter once all assembled
Better helicopter handling
Added timer countdown once helicopter engine is on, players need to fly to red circle in under 2 minutes or they'll lose the game
Added helicopter distance boundaries if player fly too far from map they will automatically lose
Made robots a little less harder to beat

notes.title: Helicopter wrong location patch
notes.content: There was a bug when the scrap helicopter was not in the middle of scrapyard but in the ground or in the sky floating, all fixed now.

notes.title: Browser scrolling bug patch
notes.content: There was not enough space to display all lobbies, its fixed now.

notes.title: Scrapvival 0.0.6 networking patch
notes.content: Added new free lobbies hosted on my server pc for players having trouble connecting to others. There will be more of them running soon.

notes.title: Network Browser Crashing Patch
notes.content: A little patch that'll fix master server crashing which was breaking the server browser.
